items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Now, you never got to hear Bolden, I guess. No, Bolden, no. [INTERVIEWEE] He was the head of my time.

ctx.x: Well, yes. I'll tell you how I heard bunk. I was in the country, and the excursion was going from New Orleans to Homer, Louisiana, and I caught the excursion at a race, and they went to Homer and stood right by him all day, listening to them blokes. That's how I met him.
Now, you never got to hear Bolden, I guess. No, Bolden, no.
He was the head of my time.
